title: Prompt Helper
description: Speeding up the work of the management team in responding, for example, if there is a problem, they will put the text in the plugin and the user will raise the problem and get an automatic response.
body:
# Prompt Helper ! 📌 A simple plugin that may be efficient in your minecraft servers. This plugin, along with the management team, can be one of the best plugins in responding to server users automatically. ❌ PromptHelper need java 17 or newer to work.
❌ You didn't need to edit Config for add prompts to gui, all added prompts automatically added in gui # Permission's 🔸 » prompthelper.admin - For reload plugin # Feature's ✅ » Gradient Support ✅ » AntiSpam ✅ » AntiExploit ✅ » Prompt GUI ✅ » Full reload ✅ » Fully Customizable # Configs config.yml ```yml menu_title: "Prompts Menu" menu_item_name: "Available Prompts" trigger_word: "arij83" # You can change this if you like that. anti_spam: enabled: true cooldown_seconds: 5 anti_exploit: max_message_length: 128 block_special_chars: true ``` messages.yml ```yml # Plugin only support minimessage colors. prefix: "[PromptHelper] " plugin_reloaded: "Plugin successfully reloaded!" no_permission: "You do not have permission to use this command!" ``` prompts.yml ```yml # You can use gradient message if you like. # Example: Hello, how can I assist you today? # Bold: This is a bold message hello phelper: "Hello, how can I assist you today?" help: "Here are the available commands..." ``` # Support If you need support to use this plugin or you have any idea for this plugin you can contact with me on discord: arezoorajaee
